test: Dedicated amplified ALSA capture input for quiet USB microphone
device: Generic USB Audio, ALSA card ID Audio
persistence_mechanism: ALSA configuration defines a softvol input and a ctl_elems hook which sets its gain each time the named input is configured
limitations: Some peaks reached full scale; future louder recordings may require lower gain.
Different utterances were used before and after the input change, so their level difference is not a calibrated same-source gain measurement.
Reboot persistence follows configuration hooks but was not verified by rebooting during this test.
Recognition accuracy with the new live input needs a separate test.
privacy: Playback was local between the user's Pi and laptop. No WAV recording or personal speech is included in this record.
